title: The 'Signal Flip' Strategy That Doubled This Candidate's Salary
description:
How to Double Your Salary in a Career Switch


Elamaran went from a £27,500 apprenticeship at BNP Paribas to a £58,000 SDR offer at Hitachi Vantara in 5 and a half months. That's a 110% pay rise, with no degree and no sales experience when we started. This video is the exact playbook we ran together. The biggest single change wasn't the CV; it was how his experience was being read. Once we flipped that signal, the CV rewrite, the LinkedIn, the final-stage prep, and the verbal offer all lined up behind it.


What you'll learn in this video:
- The single signal flip that doubled Elamaran's salary without a degree or new skills
- Why most career switchers get stuck, and how to reposition the experience you already have
- How to use a niche as a competitive wedge instead of competing head-on
- The CV and LinkedIn rewrite that made a non-sales background read as sales-ready
- How to recover from a final-stage rejection and handle the verbal offer
